lesson: When DeepEP already supplies packed integer UE8M0 scales, first prove the timed kernel sequence before adding an adapter. For small-M fused MoE decode, a wrapper-only gain must survive SwiGLU, W2, communication, graph, and end-to-end gates; otherwise retain the library kernel and stock fallback.
